knowledge:
- key_parameters: data_miss=The input matrix, data.frame, or SummarizedExperiment containing missing values ;; MCAR_algorithm=The imputation algorithm to use for MCAR/MAR values (options include "BPCA", "Multi_nsKNN", "Random Forest") ;; MNAR_algorithm=The imputation algorithm to use for MNAR values (options include "Single", "nsKNN") ;; assay_ix=Integer designating which assay to impute if the input is a SummarizedExperiment (default is 1) ;; forest_list_args=A list of arguments passed to the random forest classifier for training (e.g., ntree, proximity) ;; verbose=Logical indicating whether to print console progress messages
- alternatives: The package internally supports and allows choosing between BPCA, Multi_nsKNN, and Random Forest for MCAR/MAR imputation, and nsKNN or Single imputation for MNAR imputation.
- when_to_use: Use this package when analyzing metabolomics datasets (such as untargeted LC-MS data) that contain missing values arising from a mixture of different missingness mechanisms (both random missingness and left-censored/abundance-dependent missingness).
- pitfalls: Estimating the pattern of missingness involves randomly imposing MCAR/MAR into the data, which can introduce stochastic variation in the estimated parameters; users must set a random seed (set.seed) beforehand to ensure reproducible results.

workflows.name: data_frame_or_matrix_imputation
workflows.intent: Perform mechanism-aware imputation on a standard data.frame or matrix containing missing metabolomics values.
input: untargeted_LCMS_data (matrix or data.frame containing metabolomics abundance data with missing values)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the MAI package and example dataset ;; 2. Set a random seed for reproducibility ;; 3. Run the MAI function to classify and impute missing values ;; 4. Extract the imputed data matrix and estimated missingness parameters from the results list
workflows.code:
library(MAI)
data("untargeted_LCMS_data")
set.seed(137690)
Results = MAI(data_miss = untargeted_LCMS_data, # The data with missing values
          MCAR_algorithm = "BPCA", # The MCAR algorithm to use
          MNAR_algorithm = "Single", # The MNAR algorithm to use
          assay_ix = 1, # If SE, designates the assay to impute
          forest_list_args = list( # random forest arguments for training
            ntree = 300,
            proximity = FALSE
        ),
          verbose = TRUE # allows console message output
        )
Results[["Imputed_data"]][1:5, 1:5]
Results[["Estimated_Params"]]

workflows.name: summarized_experiment_imputation
workflows.intent: Perform mechanism-aware imputation on a SummarizedExperiment object containing missing metabolomics values.
input: se (SummarizedExperiment object containing metabolomics abundance data with missing values in its assay)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the SummarizedExperiment and MAI packages ;; 2. Convert the data to a SummarizedExperiment object ;; 3. Set a random seed for reproducibility ;; 4. Run the MAI function on the SummarizedExperiment object ;; 5. Extract the imputed assay and estimated missingness parameters from the metadata of the returned SummarizedExperiment
workflows.code:
suppressMessages(
  library(SummarizedExperiment)
)
data("untargeted_LCMS_data")
se = SummarizedExperiment(untargeted_LCMS_data)
set.seed(137690)
Results = MAI(se, # The data with missing values
          MCAR_algorithm = "BPCA", # The MCAR algorithm to use
          MNAR_algorithm= "Single", # The MNAR algorithm to use
          assay_ix = 1, # If SE, designates the assay to impute
          forest_list_args = list( # random forest arguments for training
            ntree = 300,
            proximity = FALSE
        ),
          verbose = TRUE # allows console message output
        )
assay(Results)[1:5, 1:5]
metadata(Results)[["meta_assay_1"]][["Estimated_Params"]]
